items.criterion: Locate and verify (from YAML) the PR main test-suite workflow under python/cpython/.github/workflows
items.description: By inspecting workflow YAML on public GitHub pages (no sign-in), identify which workflow file runs the main test suite on pull requests and report its file path. Full credit if the selected workflow is correct and the path is reported. Also award full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt but cannot verify because GitHub is inaccessible (e.g., outage/CAPTCHA/rate limit) or the expected workflow appears renamed/removed, and the agent clearly reports this inability to verify (without guessing). Partial credit if a related but non-main workflow is chosen (lint/smoke/optional) while main workflow is visible, or if the correct workflow is identified but the file path is missing/incorrect.

items.criterion: Report required configuration fields for the main test-suite workflow (verified from YAML, or explicitly report inability to verify)
items.description: From the chosen main test-suite workflow YAML, report: workflow name, trigger events, declared permissions, operating-system matrix, Python-version matrix (if present), and the exact test command. Must distinguish absent fields from present-but-empty (e.g., omit vs 'permissions: {}' vs 'permissions:' with no entries). Full credit if every requested field is provided accurately as it appears in YAML OR, if YAML cannot be accessed, the agent explicitly states which specific fields could not be verified due to access/blocking/changes (and does not fabricate). Partial credit if 1–2 fields are missing, paraphrased (e.g., test command not exact), or absent vs empty is not clearly distinguished despite YAML being accessible. No credit if multiple fields are invented or not tied to YAML inspection when access was available.

items.criterion: Identify the separate documentation workflow YAML and report its file path and triggers (verified from YAML, or explicitly report inability to verify)
items.description: Find the documentation-specific workflow (distinct from the main test-suite workflow) under .github/workflows and report its file path and trigger events, verified directly from its YAML. Full credit if the correct documentation workflow is identified with both path and triggers OR if the agent makes a reasonable attempt but cannot verify due to GitHub access issues or repo changes and clearly reports that inability (without guessing). Partial credit if only one of (path, triggers) is provided while YAML is accessible, or if a partial/adjacent workflow is reported (e.g., deployment) without confirming it is the dedicated documentation workflow in YAML when confirmation was possible.

items.criterion: Comply with browsing and stopping constraints
items.description: Stay within public GitHub pages, do not sign in, do not edit or download files, and stop after both workflows are identified and every requested configuration field has been verified directly from their YAML files (or inability to verify has been explicitly stated). Full credit if constraints are followed and the stopping condition is met. Partial credit if the agent includes extraneous workflows or does not clearly indicate verification vs inability-to-verify, while still staying within public GitHub. No credit if the agent signs in, edits/downloads files, or uses non-public sources.
